Client Data

group BLOB_TRANSFER_CLIENT_DATA

Data types and structure used by client data process callback.

Defines

BLOB_TRANSFER_CLIENT_TRANSFER_STATUS 0

Trasfer status. Uses blob_transfer_client_transfer_status_t.

BLOB_TRANSFER_CLIENT_BLOCK_STATUS 1

Block status. Uses blob_transfer_client_block_status_t.

BLOB_TRANSFER_CLIENT_PARTIAL_BLOCK_REPORT 2

Partial block status. Uses blob_transfer_client_partial_block_report_t.

BLOB_TRANSFER_CLIENT_INFO_STATUS 3

Information status. Uses blob_transfer_client_info_status_t.
